prompt: On a dusty attic floor, a modular roof inspection gate stands off-centre right: one latched asphalt-shingle condition bay, an empty age slot, and a blank galvanized steel rate-schedule rack rail. subject: a modular roof-deck inspection gate with one latched condition bay and one empty age slot beside a blank rate-schedule rack rail on an attic floor
core_thesis: A published 4.3% filing average hides 751,000 individual State Farm hikes, while the age-vs-condition roof rule leaves the credit for a new roof with no published amount.
core_conflict: The aggregate unweighted filing average obscures individual renewal increases, and the age-vs-condition rule shifts the barrier without a published dollar figure.
composition: extreme asymmetry, assembly off-centre right with generous negative space left

caption: One bay carries the shingles; the other carries nothing.
title: Texas's 4.3% Cut Hides 751,000 Hikes

review.depicts: A metal-framed modular assembly stands on a dusty attic floor against a white gable wall, with one hinged panel fronted in grey asphalt shingles and fitted with a metal latch, an open empty bay beside it, and a further blank galvanized panel standing open to the right, with exposed roof framing and scattered boards behind.
review.reason: The shingled condition panel, empty age slot and blank rate-schedule plate are the article's own roofing-and-rate mechanism rendered as an object, though the abstraction means it reads as a roof-condition scene rather than the specific 4.3% filing story.
